unicode_policy: Preserve input code points; no compatibility normalization is allowed inside the tokenizer. Upstream corpus text is not rewritten for stylistic regularization.
rationale: One frozen tokenizer across S0-S3 prevents tokenizer changes from masquerading as capacity effects.
Unigram segmentation is compatible with Korean subword/morphological variation without making morpheme labels an ontology.
Identity normalization avoids silently erasing orthographic distinctions; byte fallback prevents OOV collapse.
32k vocabulary keeps embedding cost manageable while allowing Korean syllable/subword coverage.
evaluation_rules: Report fertility = tokens per whitespace-delimited eojeol on fresh modern Korean diagnostics.
Report byte-fallback rate and UNK rate; UNK should be zero with byte fallback.
Do not promote lower fertility as writing-quality evidence.
No tokenizer retuning after PIA outcomes.
